title: A Village Burned, Its People Killed or Exiled. A Court Ruled It Was Genocide.
summary_full: Zammona’s erasure was part of a wider campaign of violence against Rohingya Muslims. An international court found that Myanmar was culpable for the atrocities.
summary_public: Zammona’s erasure was part of a wider campaign of violence against Rohingya Muslims. An international court found that Myanmar was culpable for the atrocities.
